reason: This Lake configuration transition moves the HexArith and HexModArith C objects onto the native carrier libraries HexArithNative and HexModArithNative so module dynlibs link on Windows, compiles those objects with -DLEAN_EXPORTING (which only sets default symbol visibility outside Windows), and drops precompileModules from libraries without externs. The same C sources reach the hexbz_factor_service executable statically, through the carriers' moreLinkObjs instead of HexArith's and HexModArith's; Lake applies only the root library's moreLinkArgs to an executable, so moving -lgmp onto the carrier does not change its link line. The executable declaration, its compiler options, its Lean sources and the pinned Mathlib revision are unchanged.
